nodes.name: drafts.jsx
nodes.summary: React form-draft hook and restore indicators, combining periodic local saves with server synchronization and user-controlled restoration.

nodes.name: useFormDraft
nodes.summary: Autosaves a form locally and remotely, then exposes restore and discard actions.

nodes.name: DraftRestoreBar
nodes.summary: Renders the user decision controls for a previously saved form draft.

nodes.name: DraftSavedHint
nodes.summary: Displays the form-draft save status.

nodes.name: draftsStore.js
nodes.summary: Framework-independent local draft store with retention and pruning, plus DOM field capture and restoration helpers.

nodes.name: draftKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable storage key for a form and its optional scope.

nodes.name: hasContent
nodes.summary: Checks recursively whether a draft contains meaningful user-entered content.

nodes.name: readDraft
nodes.summary: Reads, validates, and expires a locally stored draft.

nodes.name: saveDraft
nodes.summary: Persists a draft locally and prunes older entries when needed.

nodes.name: clearDraft
nodes.summary: Removes one locally stored draft.

nodes.name: listDrafts
nodes.summary: Lists valid drafts in newest-first order.

nodes.name: pruneDrafts
nodes.summary: Enforces the configured draft-retention count.

nodes.name: captureFields
nodes.summary: Captures eligible form fields from a DOM subtree while omitting sensitive control types.

nodes.name: applyFields
nodes.summary: Restores captured values to matching form controls and dispatches input events.

nodes.name: applyFieldsWhenReady
nodes.summary: Retries form restoration until dynamically rendered fields are available.

nodes.name: i18n.js
nodes.summary: Static Arabic-to-English interface dictionary and translation helpers for dashboard labels and generated UI text.

nodes.name: translate
nodes.summary: Looks up and formats an English translation for Arabic interface text.

nodes.name: liveToast.js
nodes.summary: Pure live-notification rules for event styling, labels, age, timing, deduplication, and earthquake alarm audio.

nodes.name: notifyVisual
nodes.summary: Maps an event type to its notification tone and icon category.

nodes.name: unlockEarthquakeSound
nodes.summary: Initializes browser audio after user interaction so later alerts can play.

nodes.name: playEarthquakeAlarm
nodes.summary: Plays the configured browser-generated earthquake alert pattern.

nodes.name: notifyLabel
nodes.summary: Returns a localized short label for a notification event type.

nodes.name: formatEventAge
nodes.summary: Formats elapsed time since an event for notification display.

nodes.name: pauseToastClock
nodes.summary: Pauses the active notification countdown.

nodes.name: resumeToastClock
nodes.summary: Resumes the notification countdown after a pause.

nodes.name: shouldExpireToast
nodes.summary: Determines whether a notification should be removed after its display interval.

nodes.name: normalizeActionText
nodes.summary: Normalizes action text before notification comparison.

nodes.name: logicalEventKey
nodes.summary: Creates a stable key for identifying logically equivalent events.

nodes.name: shouldSuppressDuplicate
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event matches a recently displayed duplicate.

nodes.name: rememberEventKey
nodes.summary: Records an event key for subsequent duplicate checks.

nodes.name: initialsFrom
nodes.summary: Derives compact initials for a notification avatar.

nodes.name: shouldPurgeToast
nodes.summary: Determines whether a queued notification is stale and should be removed.

nodes.name: playEgyptRiskAlarm
nodes.summary: Plays the browser-generated alarm used for Egypt-related risk notifications.

nodes.name: outbox.js
nodes.summary: Offline-resilient submission queue with server mirroring, rejected-item recovery, and pending weather-update synchronization.

nodes.name: readOutbox
nodes.summary: Reads the local pending-submission queue with a safe empty fallback.

nodes.name: writeOutbox
nodes.summary: Persists the pending-submission queue locally.

nodes.name: enqueueOutbox
nodes.summary: Adds or replaces a pending submission and mirrors it to the server workspace.

nodes.name: removeFromOutbox
nodes.summary: Removes a successfully handled submission from the local and remote queues.

nodes.name: pushOutboxToServer
nodes.summary: Mirrors one queued submission into the server workspace.

nodes.name: syncOutboxFromServer
nodes.summary: Merges locally queued submissions with the server-side queue.

nodes.name: readRejected
nodes.summary: Reads the locally archived rejected submissions.

nodes.name: writeRejected
nodes.summary: Persists the bounded rejected-submission archive.

nodes.name: archiveRejectedOutbox
nodes.summary: Moves a rejected submission into the recovery archive.

nodes.name: restoreRejectedToOutbox
nodes.summary: Returns an archived submission to the pending queue.

nodes.name: dropRejected
nodes.summary: Removes a selected item from the rejected-submission archive.

nodes.name: markOutboxAuthBlocked
nodes.summary: Marks queued submissions as blocked pending an authenticated session.

nodes.name: clearOutboxAuthBlocked
nodes.summary: Clears the authentication-blocked state for queued submissions.

nodes.name: outboxAuthBlockedCount
nodes.summary: Counts submissions awaiting authentication before retry.

nodes.name: loadWeatherPending
nodes.summary: Loads locally pending weather updates.

nodes.name: flushWeatherPendingToServer
nodes.summary: Uploads pending weather changes and clears them after confirmation.

nodes.name: saveWeatherPending
nodes.summary: Stores a weather change locally until it can be synchronized.

nodes.name: clearWeatherPending
nodes.summary: Removes a confirmed weather update from the pending store.

nodes.name: syncWeatherPendingFromServer
nodes.summary: Merges server-side pending weather changes into local state.

nodes.name: countWeatherPending
nodes.summary: Counts locally pending weather changes.

nodes.name: participantImport.js
nodes.summary: Spreadsheet row parser that normalizes cell text, validates participant entries, and resolves branch references.

nodes.name: parseParticipantRows
nodes.summary: Parses spreadsheet rows, validates required fields, and maps branch references.

nodes.name: timeutils.js
nodes.summary: Shared time and date-time normalization utilities that keep machine values consistent while formatting user-facing 12-hour displays.

nodes.name: normTime
nodes.summary: Converts supported time text into a normalized 24-hour machine value.

nodes.name: parseTimeText
nodes.summary: Parses pasted time text, including localized meridiem markers, into machine format.

nodes.name: formatTime12
nodes.summary: Formats normalized time values for consistent 12-hour display.

nodes.name: formatDateTime12
nodes.summary: Formats date-time values as day-first dates with 12-hour time.

nodes.name: weatherIntelFilters.js
nodes.summary: Weather intelligence helpers for extracting forecast metrics, applying phenomenon and anomaly filters, and preserving relevant snapshots.

nodes.name: getExtraWeatherValue
nodes.summary: Reads a numeric weather measure from supported forecast extensions.

nodes.name: getWeatherMetricValue
nodes.summary: Extracts the requested normalized metric from a forecast assessment.

nodes.name: getWeatherMetricClass
nodes.summary: Classifies a weather metric using its configured historical thresholds.

nodes.name: matchesWeatherPhenomenon
nodes.summary: Tests whether an assessment matches the selected weather phenomenon filter.

nodes.name: shouldPreserveWeatherSnapshot
nodes.summary: Determines whether an incoming update should retain the current weather snapshot.
